title: Multi-Layer Probe Ensembling for Sandbagging Detection

original_idea.body:
# Multi-Layer Probe Ensembling for Sandbagging Detection

**Problem:** Multi-layer ensembling for deception detection is unexplored; sandbagging is the most safety-critical deception type.

**Direction:** On an open model, construct a sandbagging model-organism and compare single-layer probes vs multi-layer ensemble at detecting the concealment state.

**Why it matters:** Sandbagging detection is a long-horizon threat labs deprioritize. No training, high counterfactual value.

**Relevant context:** arXiv 2604.13386; deception-probe work.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: sandbagging defeats safety evals, a pathway major orgs flag as critical; better detection directly helps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt-based model organism + probe ensembling; guided, eliciting sandbagging adds some difficulty.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused comparison (single vs ensemble) though organism construction adds a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism slice of a neglected long-horizon threat; open model, no training.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation extraction + probes on an open model; single mid GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Multi-layer ensembling for sandbagging is flagged as unexplored; plausibly partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Deception probing exists; multi-layer ensembling for sandbagging is noted as unexplored.
